name: Honey Maid Graham Crackers
ingredientsText: UNBLEACHED ENRICHED FLOUR (WHEAT FLOUR, NIACIN, REDUCED IRON, THIAMINE MONONITRATE (VITAMIN B1), RIBOFLAVIN (VITAMIN B2), FOLIC ACID), GRAHAM FLOUR (WHOLE GRAIN WHEAT FLOUR), SUGAR, SOYBEAN AND/OR CANOLA OIL, HONEY, LEAVENING (BAKING SODA, CALCIUM PHOSPHATE), SALT, SOY LECITHIN, ARTIFICIAL FLAVOR.
notes: OFF text ends '..., ARTIFICIAL FLAVOR, WHEAT, SOY.' with the word CONTAINS lost; treated the trailing 'WHEAT, SOY.' as the Contains line.
